Vioxx, the painkiller pulled from the market in 2004, is the cautionary tale at the heart of this Joe Rogan Experience segment. Merck sold the drug for arthritis pain before studies linked it to heart attacks and strokes. Tens of thousands of lawsuits followed the recall.

Rogan and his guest walk through what the company knew and when it knew it. They discuss how drug trials can hide risks and how regulators missed the signals. The talk widens into trust in big drug firms as a whole. It is pharma's warning story, told straight for the wary.
